summary: Harden twin-lifecycle regular-file I/O, URI segments, JSON bounds, and unhashable guards

delivery.outcome: Enforce O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK regular-file reads, URI segment traversal guards, strict JSON float/depth/key bounds, iterative secret scanning, and unhashable enum/schema guards across standard/twin_primitives.py, standard/twin_targets.py, and standard/conformance.py, add standard/test_twin_hardening.py, and close merged ticket-017.
nonGoals: Do not modify vendored standard/lifecycle*.py or frozen schema/grammar/profile/blueprint digests

architecture.decision: Keep zero-dependency twin-lifecycle conformance in standard/twin_primitives.py, standard/twin_targets.py, and standard/conformance.py under 500 lines while hardening regular-file descriptor checks, URI path segments, strict JSON bounds, iterative sensitive-field traversal, and unhashable enum/schema checks.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch commit or close the pull request before merge.
